files.description: Full HTML of the registered EHI export documentation page. Contains the complete (and very minimal) export documentation: three export formats (C-CDA, text, PDF), folder naming convention, and a link to HL7's C-CDA Companion Guide.

WordPress REST API JSON representation of the export page. Contains the page content, metadata (published 2023-11-14, never modified), and structured data. Confirms the page content is static and complete.
Full-page browser screenshot of the export documentation page, showing the complete visible content: heading, five lines of text, and footer.
Mandatory disclosures page confirming 170.315(b)(10) certification, certified criteria list, and pricing information. No additional export documentation beyond the certification listing.
